page_title: ACM 1-0 EMP | AC Milan v Empoli 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+4' Great solo effort by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
90+2' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yacine Adli (AC Milan) comes onto the pitch so that Noah Okafor can be given a rest.
88' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
87' Mattia Destro (Empoli) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His low header flies toward the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
86' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
84' Empoli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
83' Mattia Destro (Empoli) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
80' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
77' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
76' Here is a change. Szymon Zurkowski is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli).
76' Today's match ends for M'Baye Niang who will be replaced by Mattia Destro (Empoli).
76' AC Milan can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
75' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
74' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Elia Caprile is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
73' Luka Jovic goes off the pitch and Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) comes on.
70' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.

66' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' Stefano Pioli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pierre Kalulu (AC Milan) replacing Fikayo Tomori.
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) is replacing Christian Pulisic.
62' Substitution. Tijjani Reijnders will be replaced by Yunus Musah (AC Milan).
60' Luka Jovic (AC Milan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
59' Empoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.
55' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) replaces Giuseppe Pezzella.
55' That will be all from Jacopo Fazzini who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli).
55' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
53' Booking. Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) receives a caution from the referee.
50' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
48' The ball rebounds out to Davide Calabria (AC Milan) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
46' The Empoli players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Juan Luca Sacchi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The resulting set piece from AC Milan is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
42' Ardian Ismajli doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
41' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) goes wild in celebration.
41' Wait! Referee Juan Luca Sacchi immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
41' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
40' 1 - 0 Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
39' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
35' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) makes a slide tackle, but referee Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
34' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle after Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
33' The ball possession at the moment is 78:22.
32' AC Milan take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
32' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
29' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
28' A lofted cross from Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
26' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
24' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
21' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
20' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) takes the corner but it's cleared.
19' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
18' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) tackles a bit over-zealously and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
17' Now AC Milan have a corner.
16' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
15' An attempted cross from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is cleared.
13' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
13' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
12' The ball is cleared after Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) commits a foul and Juan Luca Sacchi immediately signals a free kick.
9' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
6' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
5' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
5' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Elia Caprile was alert and made an astonishing save!
4' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
4' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Noah Okafor (AC Milan).
3' Empoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi sees the trip by M'Baye Niang (Empoli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! AC Milan will take the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi was nominated as the referee for this game.
